versions.changelog:
Initial release of Image Inpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy:

- Enables mask-driven image inpainting via the runcomfy CLI, routing to Z-Image Turbo Inpainting for precise region edits.
- Automatically falls back to instruction-driven edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't provided.
- Supports use cases like object removal, watermark cleanup, region replacement, and blemish fixes.
- Detailed CLI usage instructions and model selection guidance included.
- Requires the runcomfy CLI and a valid RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
